module.purpose: Creates primitive atoms for each item in an array atom, enabling efficient per-item state management with automatic synchronization between the source array and individual item atoms.
module.summary: This module provides a splitAtom utility that transforms a single array atom into a list of individual primitive atoms, one per array item. It maintains synchronization between the source array and individual atoms, supports key-based item identification for reordering, and handles insert/remove/move actions efficiently through caching and memoization. The implementation uses WeakMaps for memory-safe caching and provides both read-only and writable atom variants depending on the input atom type.
module.businessContext: Enables granular state management in React applications where array items need independent state. If this fails, components lose ability to manage individual list items efficiently, causing unnecessary re-renders or state loss.
functions: getCached (~L7-8): Retrieves or creates cached values using a WeakMap with a factory function.
memo2 (~L10-13): Two-level memoization using nested WeakMaps for dependency tracking.
isWritable (~L16-19): Type guard that checks if an atom supports write operations.

detail.name: getCached
detail.signature: function getCached<T>(cache: Map<any, T>, key: any, creator: () => T): T
preconditions: cache is a valid Map instance (or Map-compatible object with .get/.set/.has)
creator is a synchronous function that returns a value of type T
postconditions: Returns the previously cached value for key if it existed, otherwise returns the value produced by creator()
After the call, cache.get(key) === return value (the value is stored for subsequent lookups)
invariants: For a given key, creator() is invoked at most once per cache lifetime (idempotent caching)
The returned reference is referentially stable for repeated calls with the same key
edgeCases: If cache already contains key, creator is never called and the existing value is returned
If creator returns a falsy value (null, undefined, 0, false), it is still stored and returned on subsequent calls (no falsey-bypass)
If the same key is inserted with different values externally between calls, the last externally-set value is returned
stateMutations: cache (Map) — may call cache.set(key, creator()) on a cache miss
detail.summary: Generic get-or-create cache utility: looks up a key in a Map and, on miss, invokes a creator function, stores the result, and returns it. Provides O(1) amortised access to lazily-initialized derived values.

detail.name: splitAtom
detail.signature: export function splitAtom<Item, Key>(arrAtom: WritableAtom<Item[], [Item[]], void> | Atom<Item[]>, keyExtractor?: (item: Item) => Key): WritableAtom<PrimitiveAtom<Item>[], [SplitAtomAction<Item>], void> | Atom<Atom<Item>[]>
preconditions: arrAtom must be a valid atom containing an array of items
If keyExtractor is provided, it must be a function that returns a unique key for each item in the array
postconditions: Returns an atom containing an array of atoms, one for each item in the original array
If the input arrAtom is writable, the returned atom is writable and supports split actions (insert/remove)
Each item atom reads the current value from the original array using the key-based index
Item atoms are reused (stable reference) across updates when their key matches the previous mapping
invariants: The order of item atoms in the returned array matches the order of items in the original array
Each item atom maintains a consistent key-based identity for the lifetime of the mapping
edgeCases: Empty input array: returns an empty array of item atoms
No keyExtractor provided: uses array index as key, causing atoms to be recreated on index changes
Key collision in input array: last item with a duplicate key wins the atom in the mapping
Reading a stale atom after item removal: returns the last known item value in non-production, throws in production
Writing to a stale atom after item removal: throws 'splitAtom: index out of bounds for write'

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Returns stale value in non-production, throws in production

detail.summary: Splits a base array atom into an array of individual item atoms. When provided with a keyExtractor, it maintains stable atom references across updates using a mapping cache.
